samples.summary: Owner-only Workspace Name / URL edit forms remain ungated after this change
samples.evidence: The change gates Invites, remove-member, API Keys and Danger Zone behind `isOwner`, but the two edit forms above them are still rendered to every member: `packages/frontend/src/app/workspaces/workspace-settings.tsx:238-259` (name) and `:271-293` (slug), both submitting `updateMutation` → `updateWorkspace` (`workspace-settings.tsx:97-99`). The backend rejects both for non-owners — `WorkspaceService.update` calls `assertOwner` (`packages/backend/src/workspace/workspace.service.ts:69`). So a non-owner still sees editable inputs plus a Save button that can only produce "Failed to update workspace". The branch's own plan asks for exactly this sweep: `docs/tasks/active/20260809-workspace-settings-owner-gating-todo.md:29` ("Verify no other owner-only control on the page is ungated"), and the completion note `docs/tasks/active/20260809-workspace-settings-owner-gating-lessons.md:20-23` records "None" as follow-ups. Fix belongs on the new code in workspace-settings.tsx.

samples.summary: Self-removal (the one member action this change deliberately keeps) leaves the workspace list in other components stale
samples.evidence: The change makes the trash icon on the viewer's own row the sole surviving member action for non-owners (`workspace-settings.tsx:325-338`), i.e. a "leave workspace" affordance. Its mutation only invalidates `["workspaces", workspaceId]` (`workspace-settings.tsx:135-137`). react-query prefix-matching does not invalidate the shorter key `["workspaces"]`, which is what the sidebar and every shell read: `packages/frontend/src/app/Layout.tsx:42`, `packages/frontend/src/app/files/file-shell.tsx:50`, `packages/frontend/src/app/documents/document-detail.tsx:167`, `packages/frontend/src/app/docs/docs-detail.tsx:98`, `packages/frontend/src/app/board/board-detail.tsx:43`, `packages/frontend/src/app/home-or-redirect.tsx:18`. After leaving, the workspace stays listed in the switcher and re-entering 403s; the settings page also just refetches into the generic "Failed to load workspace." state (`workspace-settings.tsx:210-220`) with no redirect. Compare `updateMutation`, which does invalidate `["workspaces"]` (`workspace-settings.tsx:101`). Pre-existing, but this change is what promotes the path to the member's only action.
